create or replace function cu_sqladd(a bigint,b bigint) returns bigint language sql as '$1+$2'

create or replace function cu_json(a varchar) returns bigint language sql as 'cast(json_extract($1,''$.v'') as bigint)'

create or replace function cu_pyadd(a bigint,b bigint) returns bigint language python as $$
def add(a,b):
 return None if a is None or b is None else a+b
$$ handler 'add'

create or replace function cu_pystr(a text) returns text language python as $$
def echo(a):
 return None if a is None else a+'|中文😀'
$$ handler 'echo'

create or replace function cu_pyvec(a bigint,b bigint) returns bigint language python as $$
def vadd(a,b):
 return [None if x is None or y is None else x+y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
vadd.vector=True
$$ handler 'vadd'

create or replace function cu_pyerr(a bigint) returns bigint language python as $$
def bad(a):
 raise ValueError('MO_CASE_INTENTIONAL_ERROR_'+str(a))
$$ handler 'bad'

drop task if exists ct_success
create task ct_success as begin insert into ct_sink select kind,cid,v from ct_control where kind=0; end
drop task if exists ct_gate_false
create task ct_gate_false when (exists(select 1 from ct_control where kind=1 and ready=1)) as begin insert into ct_sink select kind,cid,v from ct_control where kind=1; end
drop task if exists ct_gate_true
create task ct_gate_true when (exists(select 1 from ct_control where kind=2 and ready=1)) as begin insert into ct_sink select kind,cid,v from ct_control where kind=2; end
drop task if exists ct_abort
create task ct_abort as begin call cp_task_abort(); end
drop task if exists ct_error
create task ct_error as begin insert into ct_missing values(1); end
drop task if exists ct_idempotent
create task ct_idempotent as begin insert into ct_sink select kind,cid,v from ct_control where kind=5 and not exists(select 1 from ct_sink where cid=ct_control.cid); end
